extraction_notes: Supporting Information tables/figures were not included in the prompt, so actual metal loadings and additional TOFs said to be in Table S1 were unavailable except where printed in the main text. Literature-comparison values in Table 1 and text citations were not extracted. Figure-only rates were read approximately from labelled axes and marked with qualifier '~'. H/D isotope-study ion currents and N2 isotope-exchange activation-energy data were not extracted because they do not report an NH3 synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF for plant-model performance.
